description: April 3 birthday meaning: Aries decan 2, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 3 birthday falls in Aries, in the second decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Sun as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of an April 3 birthday
paragraphs: April 3 combines the expressive 3 with the theatrical second decan of Aries, the Sun around thirteen degrees in. The result is often described as a natural performer: energetic, charming and keen to be seen. Interpretive traditions suggest such a person thrives with a stage of some kind, whether a classroom, a pitch meeting or a kitchen table.

By noon UTC on April 3, the Sun has normally reached roughly 13° of Aries. That places the date in the Aries decan that astrologers give to Sun, the second of three. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aries the Sun takes over as sub-ruler, lending this middle decan some of Leo's warmth and sense of occasion. The Martian drive is still there, yet it is often aimed at something worth being seen for: a cause, a team, a creative project with their name on it. Traditional writers associate this stretch with pride in the good sense, a wish to lead by example rather than by force. Generosity tends to come easily, and so can a sensitivity to being overlooked. A useful question for these Aries natives is whose applause actually matters, since chasing everyone's can scatter a strong fire.

sections.heading: Numerology of the April 3 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 3rd, you carry a birthday number of 3 in its simplest form. As a supporting number, the day of birth is read as a gift that shows in everyday style rather than in the larger direction of a life. The single-digit 3 is traditionally associated with expression: talking, writing, making things, finding the joke in a heavy afternoon. Its energy is light and spontaneous, often called youthful whatever the person's age. Numerologists tend to suggest that 3s benefit from finishing what they begin, because their ideas are worth more completed than merely sketched in a notebook.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same April 3 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: April 3 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 3 is the 93rd day of the year (94th in a leap year). In most years Taurus season is under way by April 20, 17 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 3 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. April 3 is also the birthday of Marlon Brando (1924), Helmut Kohl (1930) and Jane Goodall (1934).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 3?
faq.answer: April 3 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aries, which tradition links with Sun.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 3?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 3 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 3rd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 3?
faq.answer: By April 3 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 3?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an April 3 birthday are Marlon Brando (1924), Helmut Kohl (1930) and Jane Goodall (1934). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
